# Steal An Egg Wiki

> Independent English Roblox wiki for Steal An Egg by and Collect Rare Pets, Place ID 107778070777162.

## Core pages

- [Homepage](https://steal-an-egg.github.io/): Game entity, gameplay loop and wiki topic hub

## Accuracy policy

The wiki does not invent egg odds, pet income, upgrade costs, code rewards or update dates. Unconfirmed values are marked as not verified.

## Enchanted Forest entity and gameplay guides

- [Enchanted Mutation](https://steal-an-egg.github.io/mutations/enchanted/): Named mutation and Enchanted Essence acquisition, with sourced crafting context and no fixed disputed multiplier
- [Enchanted Tree](https://steal-an-egg.github.io/guide/enchanted-tree/): Tree location, Wisp access, interior features and troubleshooting using current evidence
- [Spirit Panda](https://steal-an-egg.github.io/pets/spirit-panda/): Individual pet source, reported Cosmic classification and progression checks without predicted income
- [Royal Skywhale](https://steal-an-egg.github.io/pets/royal-skywhale/): Individual pet source, reported Divine classification and fusion context without a fixed recipe or income
- [Celestial Sunlion](https://steal-an-egg.github.io/pets/celestial-sunlion/): Individual pet source, reported Eternal classification, guardian distinction and value checks
- [Spirit World Guardian](https://steal-an-egg.github.io/pets/spirit-world-guardian/): Fusion pet intent, reported source and rarity, with conflicting requirements and unknown base income kept explicit

## November 4, 2026 additions

- [Fuse Machine](https://steal-an-egg.github.io/guide/fuse-machine/): Ordinary pet-fusion mechanic: reported requirements, outputs, risks and difference from Divine Fusion. Rules are update-sensitive; input count, same species and base location are public reports. No invented odds, cost or guaranteed output.
- [Value Calculator](https://steal-an-egg.github.io/calculator/value/): Interactive earning-value calculator with transparent user-entered income, custom modifiers, quantity, timed earnings and two-setup comparisons. Value means earning power; example defaults, no official trade-price claim or price database.
